import sys

def setup(maxVal, mod):
    inv = [1] * (maxVal + 1)
    p = [1] * (maxVal + 1)
    for i in range(2, maxVal + 1):
        inv[i] = (mod - mod // i) * inv[mod % i] % mod
        p[i] = p[i - 1] * i % mod
    for i in range(2, maxVal + 1):
        inv[i] = inv[i - 1] * inv[i] % mod
    return inv, p

def power_mod(base, exp, mod):
    res = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = res * base % mod
        base = base * base % mod
        exp >>= 1
    return res

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    n, k, mod = map(int, data)
    inv, p = setup(n + 5, mod)
    if n % 2 == 1:
        print(power_mod(k, n, mod))
    else:
        special_nums = []
        for i in range(2, n + 1, 2):
            if (i & n) == i:
                special_nums.append(i)
        dp = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(20)]
        total = 0
        dp[0][n] = 1
        limit = min(17, k)
        for i in range(1, limit + 1):
            sum_ = 0
            for x in special_nums:
                if dp[i - 1][x] == 0:
                    continue
                mask = x & (x - 1)
                step = mask ^ x
                v = step
                while v <= mask:
                    if (v & mask) == v:
                        val_dp = (dp[i - 1][x] * p[x] % mod) * inv[v] % mod * inv[x - v] % mod
                        dp[i][v] = (dp[i][v] + val_dp) % mod
                    v += step
                sum_ = (sum_ + dp[i - 1][x]) % mod
            total += sum_ * pow(inv[k - i], 1, mod) % mod
        final_ans = power_mod(k, n, mod) - p[k] * total % mod
        final_ans = (final_ans % mod + mod) % mod
        print(final_ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
